description: Sign a LinkedIn account in with the member's own email and password. DO NOT ASK ANYONE FOR A PASSWORD IN A CONVERSATION: send them POST /linkedin/connect/link {action: connect} instead, which gives a one-hour link to a page of ours where the password is typed, and which asks for whatever LinkedIn wants next -- a verification code, or an approval in its app. This route is for a caller with its own sign-in form. The password is forwarded once and never stored. LinkedIn answers most first sign-ins with a challenge, so a 201 here usually means the account was challenged rather than connected — follow up on POST /linkedin/connect/checkpoint. -- MakeHybrid API plan, POST /linkedin/connect/credentials, group connect.
